title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.2 Context-Pack Manifest
description: Machine-readable manifest emitted by scripts/autoresearch_context_pack_compiler.py (issue #412, parent #409). One manifest per (role, project, source_revision, eval_case, candidate_patch_hash) combination. Governs docs/standards/AUTORESEARCH_V02_LIVE_CONTRACT.md's context_manifest_hash field (issue #411, reused unchanged).

context_id.description: Deterministic id: sha256('{role}:{project}:{source_revision}:{candidate_patch_hash}') truncated to 16 hex chars, human-legible and stable for identical inputs.

project.description: Reuses PROJECT_CAPABILITIES.yaml's namespace verbatim (same enum as schemas/autoresearch_eval_case.schema.json's expected_primary_owner).

source_revision.description: The exact Git revision (full sha) the context was compiled from.

candidate_patch_hash.description: null for subject_baseline/researcher/semantic_judge-without-a-candidate-under-review; the sha256 of the applied patch for subject_candidate.

forbidden_source_classes.description: The source classes this role's compiler run refused to include, by construction -- e.g. semantic_judge always forbids project_instructions.

context_hash.description: sha256 over the concatenation of every ordered_sources[].content_hash in order, plus role and candidate_patch_hash -- the single deterministic fingerprint of this exact context.

limitations.const: This context is a reproducible repository-derived replay of AI-OS instructions and governed sources. It is not evidence of exact equivalence to proprietary ChatGPT Project runtime assembly unless separately validated.
